order.algorithm: ascending SHA256(seed + NUL + label), then label

execution.executor: root only, after exact source/plan/dataset/executor/preflight freeze and independent review
execution.sessions: Exactly one fresh isolated cold authenticated HTTP/WebSocket session per input; no context/cache reuse between inputs.
execution.providerRetries: Existing runtime only, within3Jev/2search/3contents attempts and the unchanged10-second deadline. Every attempt is charged.
execution.continueOrdinaryFailures: Record wrong labels, abstentions and ordinary operational failures and continue unstarted cases when safe. No replacement input or denominator removal.
stopConditions: Actual unsafe private-query exposure or result-span exposure halts. Guarded unapproved admission/query/span failures are recorded as failures and continue with isolated unstarted cases when safe.
Global/per-case hard budget or unknown completed usage
execution.queries: Exact admitted public allowlist span, or existing balanced_evidence alternate built only from that same span. No ground-truth URL injection or answer-directed rewrite.
execution.controls: Empty public allowlists: zero retrieval and no factual verdict, even though authored synthetic inputs are shareable.
execution.environment: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 for actual Node requests; keys only in environment, never printed/published.

prospectiveMetrics.denominators: All80declared facts40true/40false;20controls separate. No-result/errors/unrun remain in declared coverage; all styles and eight10-fact domains retain their denominators.
rawAndSourceCoverage: Definitive cases with>=1verifiedselected reference separately; never substitute for fullselected credit
prospectiveMetrics.binaryTruthConfusion: Knowntrue/knownfalse rows; predicted supported/contradicted/misleading/insufficient_evidence/no_result/not_observed columns; abstentions never correct true negatives.
prospectiveMetrics.falseAlarm: Knowntrue predicted contradicted OR misleading. Report count, declared40, completed valid checks including explicit abstentions, and definitive-only denominators separately.
prospectiveMetrics.falseSupport: Knownfalse predicted supported. Report count, declared40, completed valid checks including explicit abstentions, and definitive-only denominators separately.
prospectiveMetrics.errorDenominatorCaveat: Invalid/duplicate/no-result/unobserved observations are never observed negatives. Show their counts; do not claim a low completed-case rate establishes declared-cohort success.
prospectiveMetrics.controlConfusion: Expected skip/needs_confirmation versus actual action, provider error or missing. Report false public admission/20, actual retrieval attempts/20, manual response and factual verdicts separately.
prospectiveMetrics.styleAndDomain: Report all coverage/confusion/admission/error rates by eight domains, three factual styles, true/false polarity and conversational combined; no pooling historical cohorts.
prospectiveMetrics.admission: Exact public-span precision/recall, misses, false admissions and unsafe blocked attempts. First-person full/bare accepted variants match one expected proposition only.
prospectiveMetrics.latency: All80factual cold per-input duration including abstentions/errors/timeouts; median and nearest-rankP95. Controls20 and wholecampaign wall separate; report any unrun denominator.
prospectiveMetrics.providerAccounting: Actual dispatched Jev/search/contents attempts, retries, requestbytes, measured usage, pending/unknown reservations, known partial cost and unknown-cost attempts. Response-byte aggregate stays unmeasured unless actually captured.
prospectiveMetrics.citationReview: Independent agent direct inspection of every originally selected reference: exact ID/URL/excerpt hash, relation/value/scope, access failures, retained proof and provenance/dependence. No unselected substitution or hostshortcut.

wilson95.method: Wilson score interval for k/n: center=(k/n+z²/(2n))/(1+z²/n); half=z*sqrt((k/n)*(1-k/n)/n+z²/(4n²))/(1+z²/n). Returnnull for n=0.
applyTo: Falsealarm completed valid and definitive-only rates
Falsesupport completed valid and definitive-only rates
wilson95.interpretation: Mathematical binomial intervals are descriptive under an IID Bernoulli assumption not established by this purposive correlated synthetic cohort. They are not population confidence guarantees.

criteria.interpretation: Development targets only; every adverse result/failure is preserved. No target or zero-error observation certifies readiness.

privacy: Every input is authored synthetic fiction, explicitly shareable as a reusable dataset. No actual private participant data. Public retrieval remains exact-safe-span only; runtime reports omit private-capable originals.
scope: New OPEN prospective campaign. No historical authorization reuse, old study rerun/resumption, baseline causal comparison or blind evaluation claim.
